_readme: HOW TO USE: copy this file to server-config.json (same folder) and fill in your keys.
server-config.json is NEVER committed to git, and is only served to devices
on your home network via /config.js — it is never exposed to the internet.
Lines starting with _ are just notes; the server ignores them.
_section_server: Port the home server listens on.
_section_hardcover: Hardcover token — series info, content warnings, moods. Free token: hardcover.app → Account settings → API.
_section_google_books: Google Books API key — personal quota of 1,000 requests/day (the shared anonymous quota can run out). Get one: Google Cloud Console → enable the 'Books API' → Credentials → Create an API key (restrict it to the Books API).
_section_supabase: Supabase — optional cloud sync. Supabase dashboard → Project Settings → API.
